name: LAB-Bench
description: LAB-Bench is a broad benchmark dataset with over 2,400 multiple choice questions designed to evaluate language models on practical biology research tasks. These include literature search, protocol planning, data analysis, figure interpretation, database navigation, and DNA/protein sequence comprehension and manipulation. It aims to assess AI systems' utility as research assistants in biology.
reputation: A newer but increasingly cited benchmark for evaluating whether models can handle practical biology-research workflows rather than just textbook biology QA.
notes: Designed for practical biology research tasks rather than textbook knowledge; publicly available subset.
